title: Bound a penetration test before choosing modules
description: Choose a target boundary, access profile, validation depth, and concurrency. This transparent lesson model updates work, evidence volume, execution waves, and the safety decision together; it is not an industry benchmark or a vulnerability forecast.

targetBoundaries.label: Isolated lab
targetBoundaries.detail: Six disposable targets with synthetic identities, data, and network routes.

targetBoundaries.label: Production canary
targetBoundaries.detail: Twelve named targets representing one production service and owner.

targetBoundaries.label: Broad production segment
targetBoundaries.detail: Thirty-six targets spanning several owners and failure domains.

accessProfiles.label: External only
accessProfiles.detail: Model public entry points without test credentials or internal context.

accessProfiles.label: Authenticated application
accessProfiles.detail: Include approved user roles and application-side evidence for deeper control checks.

accessProfiles.label: Hybrid assumed access
accessProfiles.detail: Combine external, authenticated, and approved internal perspectives.

validationDepths.label: Enumerate exposure
validationDepths.detail: Record reachable services, versions, roles, and candidate weaknesses without attempting exploitation.

validationDepths.label: Controlled validation
validationDepths.detail: Confirm selected weaknesses with the least-impacting approved proof and immediate cleanup.

validationDepths.label: Attack-path validation
validationDepths.detail: Validate an approved multi-step path, including a bounded session or pivot and explicit stop points.
